In the single file ap-web/src/pages/PatternsPage.tsx, make exactly this change:

Use the trailing-slash path 'api/v1/memories/?tag=discover-candidate&limit=50' for the Discover fetch. Render loading, empty and failed as three visually distinct states. A failed fetch shows a plain error line plus a Retry control, and never shows the string about the scout automaton not having shipped.

Keep the change minimal and confined to that file and its test.

HOW TO WORK:
  - Read the file with read_file before changing it. Never edit a file you have not successfully read, and never invent its contents.
  - Make the change with a write_file call containing the complete new file contents.
  - Then run BOTH gate commands verbatim as run_shell calls:
      npm --prefix ap-web run type-check
      npm --prefix ap-web test
    Run them exactly as written. A scoped variant (adding a filename) does not satisfy the gate.
  - Set done=true once the edit is written and both commands have been run.
  - You MAY also update that file's co-located *.test.tsx when your change alters an exported type or prop the test consumes — a type-check failure in the sibling test is part of this change, not a reason to revert it. Never delete a test, rename it away, or mark it skip/todo/only to make the gate pass; update it to match the new contract.
  - Change nothing else.
  - Write ONE file per response. If both the source and its test need changing, do them as two separate write_file calls in two separate turns — never both in a single response.
  - If you are challenged and asked to try again, RE-EMIT the complete write_file tool_call. A response containing only {"done": true}, with no tool_calls, is never sufficient: the previous turn's proposal is not carried forward for you. State the full call again every time.
